evidence.title: Participant flow: A Study of LY3437943 in Participants Who Have Obesity or Are Overweight
evidence.text: Participant flow for trial NCT04881760 (A Study of LY3437943 in Participants Who Have Obesity or Are Overweight). Participants by group: 12 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): started 62, completed 54; 1 mg LY3437943: started 69, completed 60; 4 mg LY3437943: started 34, completed 26; 4 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): started 33, completed 26; 8 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): started 35, completed 30; 8 mg LY3437943 (4 mg): started 35, completed 29; Placebo: started 70, completed 50. Reasons for not completing (number of participants): 12 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): Lost to Follow-up (4), Adverse Event (2), Withdrawal by Subject (2), Site Closure (0), Death (0), Inadvertent Enrollment (0); 1 mg LY3437943: Lost to Follow-up (7), Adverse Event (1), Withdrawal by Subject (1), Death (0), Randomized but Never Treated (0), Site Closure (0); 4 mg LY3437943: Withdrawal by Subject (4), Lost to Follow-up (1), Death (1), Randomized but Never Treated (1), Site Closure (1), Inadvertent Enrollment (0); 4 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): Lost to Follow-up (5), Withdrawal by Subject (1), Adverse Event (1), Inadvertent Enrollment (0), Randomized but Never Treated (0), Site Closure (0); 8 mg LY3437943 (2 mg): Withdrawal by Subject (2), Lost to Follow-up (2), Adverse Event (1), Inadvertent Enrollment (0), Site Closure (0), Randomized but Never Treated (0); 8 mg LY3437943 (4 mg): Lost to Follow-up (4), Adverse Event (1), Withdrawal by Subject (1), Death (0), Inadvertent Enrollment (0), Randomized but Never Treated (0); Placebo: Withdrawal by Subject (13), Lost to Follow-up (5), Inadvertent Enrollment (2), Death (0), Randomized but Never Treated (0), Site Closure (0).
